Wednesday Night Pedal House Ride

Laramie, WY · Downtown · Road

Wednesday Night Pedal House Ride is a road group ride in Laramie, WY. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:00 pm from Pedal House. Pace: paceline; regroups, everyone returns together.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: paceline; regroups, everyone returns together. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @pedal_house the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Night Pedal House Ride group ride

Laramie's shop road ride, focused on paceline riding. It is a drop ride, but the group regroups and everyone rides back together. Pedal House has been in town since 1990.
